entries.zh: 欺（欺凌、欺侮人；亏待、冤枉）
entries.en: to wrong, mistreat; to bully, deceive

entries.zh: 欺负（欺侮人；亏待人）
entries.en: to bully, mistreat; to take advantage of, wrong

entries.zh: 欺凌（欺侮凌辱；嘲弄欺压）
entries.en: to bully and insult; to mock, deride

entries.zh: 欺压（欺侮并压迫）
entries.en: to bully and oppress, keep down

entries.zh: 欺谋：用计谋欺侮人；（大者）欺负（小者）、以强凌弱
entries.en: to wrong by scheming; the greater wrongs the lesser
entries.notes: 「欺謀」搭配罕见，第二字音读（bōu/mōu）近「謀」亦近「負」白读，字形两可，义从 L『大欺小』为主

entries.zh: 凌（凌辱、欺凌；冒犯侮辱）
entries.en: to insult, outrage; to bully

entries.zh: （他）亏待了我、欺负了我（原件字形作「開我」）
entries.en: he wronged me, took unfair advantage of me
entries.notes: H 作「開我」，与第10条「虧我」音读全同（khui-gùa），疑形近误认或原稿异写，义从 L『agrauiome』

entries.zh: 亏心事（昧良心、亏待他人的事）；诬枉、捏造冤屈
entries.en: to do a deed that wrongs one's conscience; to defame, bear false witness

entries.zh: 亏失（亏损、使人受损失；亏待人）
entries.en: loss, detriment; to wrong (someone) to their loss

entries.zh: 亏我（他亏待了我、叫我吃亏）
entries.en: he wronged me, got the better of me

entries.zh: 殴（殴打、殴击人）
entries.en: to beat, strike (a person)

entries.zh: 殴辱（殴打并侮辱；欺凌辱骂）
entries.en: to beat and humiliate; to insult, outrage

entries.zh: 殴蛮（蛮横殴打、粗暴欺人）；冒犯、得罪
entries.en: to beat brutally, mistreat; to offend
entries.notes: 「蠻」取义两可（蛮横／蛮人），与 L『agrauiar, ofender』对应稍宽，姑取蛮横殴打之义

entries.zh: 害（加害、伤害；损害人）
entries.en: to harm, injure; to do evil to

entries.zh: 歆我（歆羡、贪慕我）——与 L『agrauiome（欺我）』不合，释义存疑
entries.en: he coveted/envied me (L 'agrauiome' = he wronged me; columns conflict, uncertain)
entries.notes: H/M/R 一致作「歆我」（贪慕我），与 L『agrauiome＝欺我』语义不合，疑西语词头原为 envidiome（嫉妒我）之类，无从核实

entries.zh: 歪（冤枉、歪曲；使人受屈）
entries.en: to wrong unjustly; to twist, pervert

entries.zh: 枉屈（冤屈、使人受冤枉）
entries.en: to wrong unjustly; injustice, grievance

entries.zh: 枉人（冤枉他人、屈人）
entries.en: to wrong a person, do someone injustice

entries.zh: 负（辜负、亏待人；欺负）
entries.en: to let down, wrong; to be ungrateful to

entries.zh: 负义（忘恩负义；背恩无礼）
entries.en: to be ungrateful, betray kindness; to behave rudely in ingratitude

entries.zh: 强（强夺、强行加害；强迫）
entries.en: to wrong by force; to force, compel

entries.zh: 强挟人（以强力挟制人、强逼人）
entries.en: to coerce a person by force, strong-arm someone
